purpose: Public metadata for independently downloading the fixed catalog-evolution inputs; this is not upstream source redistribution or a completed study.

selection.primary_sampling: 17 snapshots produce16 source-update batches; not128 individually timed updates.
selection.secondary_sampling: ALL production catalog-changing parent->commit transitions in each pinned128 first-parent window; explanatory event-conditioned input.
selection.anchor_rule: Keep the first24 unique direct module.body FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef path:symbol keys ordered by SHA256(UTF-8(path + ":" + symbol)); never replace missing or ambiguous anchors.

primary_sampling.interpretation: 16 source batches of 8 first-parent transitions; not timing every one of 128 commits

input_rule.secondary_sampling: retain ALL production catalog add/delete event parent->commit pairs within the same pinned128 first-parent transition window; explanatory event-conditioned analysis only

licenses.notice: Upstream sources are independently licensed. Downloaded code and exact root license texts stay outside Git. This repository redistributes only metadata and source links. Root text observations do not establish every embedded fragment or new gold license.

root_text_observations.rq/rq: Root text has two BSD redistribution conditions plus disclaimer.
root_text_observations.modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk: Root text is titled MIT License and includes the standard MIT grant/notice/disclaimer.
root_text_observations.scrapy/scrapy: Root text has three BSD conditions including no-endorsement, plus disclaimer.
root_text_observations.pypa/hatch: Root text is titled MIT License and includes the standard MIT grant/notice/disclaimer.
